text:
Recent work supports investigating negative quality, but does not establish gains for this BERT4Rec benchmark. [NARec (2025)](https://ietresearch.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1049/aie2.70004) excludes sequences sharing the anchor’s target from hard-negative selection, then samples probabilistically among similar histories with different targets; its full method also trains a negative augmenter. [CATS (2026)](https://iris.uniroma1.it/handle/11573/1775773) treats the positive item’s cluster as a false-negative risk and progressively shifts sampling toward neighboring clusters. Both motivate diverse, moderately hard negatives rather than always selecting the highest-scoring candidate; different targets alone do not guarantee true negatives.

[SID4SRec (2026)](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0950705126010221) explicitly filters semantically overlapping negatives at sequence and item levels, reporting gains with training-only auxiliary objectives. Its diffusion augmentation and category/brand features make the complete method unsuitable for direct adoption under the available-data constraints. Earlier [UFNRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.04116) converts suspected false negatives into positives using teacher soft labels; that teacher-based recipe does not match the requested direction.

A compatible experimental hypothesis: retain masked-target BERT4Rec and add low-weight contrastive consistency between two dropout views of the same masked context, sharing all encoder weights. Preserve repeated interactions and order; hide every occurrence of the selected target in both views to prevent leakage. Exclude same-user/same-target pairs from contrastive negatives, conservatively downweight overlapping histories, and mix random with moderately hard negatives using the current model. These are proposed adaptations, not demonstrated improvements. Include an augmentation-only control: [WWW 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11136) found augmentation alone could match or outperform some contrastive methods. Select by macro validation HR@10; inference remains one BERT4Rec checkpoint per category.
